lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. Audit Area 27 (Missing Patient Review Instrument) states no observation/look-back window. A 7-day look-back is stated only for a different audit area (Area 30, 'Patient Review Instrument Invalid Resident not on site for the look back period', p. 18), and the document does not extend it to Area 27. The page does state a service-date scope for this area: the page header reads '(For Service Dates 01/01/2013 through 02/28/2015)' and the section heading reads 'For Services Dates Prior to 03/01/2015', with the note that findings below were phased out per NYS DOH Medicaid Update, February 2013, Vol. 29, No. 3.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the Patient Review Instrument applicable for the claim under review is missing, the claim will be disallowed.
